RUNTIME_OBSERVATION.assertion_contract: Artifact records a continuous runtime observation of the bound environment for at least the required duration.
RUNTIME_OBSERVATION.attestation_model: evidence_kind + artifact bytes at bound source SHA + independent verifier; duration/sample read from artifact observation

REGIME_COVERAGE.assertion_contract: Artifact enumerates distinct validated regimes; sample_size is the count of distinct regimes and must be >= 2 for 'múltiples regímenes'.
REGIME_COVERAGE.attestation_model: evidence_kind + artifact bytes at bound source SHA + independent verifier; regime count read from artifact observation sample_size

BYPASS_AUDIT.assertion_contract: Artifact is an independent audit attesting zero bypass events during the bound window.
BYPASS_AUDIT.attestation_model: evidence_kind + artifact bytes at bound source SHA + independent verifier; zero condition attested by the independent audit artifact itself

LEDGER_RECONCILIATION.assertion_contract: Artifact is an independent reconciliation attesting zero ledger inconsistencies during the bound window.
LEDGER_RECONCILIATION.attestation_model: evidence_kind + artifact bytes at bound source SHA + independent verifier; zero condition attested by the independent reconciliation artifact itself

DUPLICATE_ORDER_AUDIT.assertion_contract: Artifact is an independent audit attesting zero duplicate orders during the bound window.
DUPLICATE_ORDER_AUDIT.attestation_model: evidence_kind + artifact bytes at bound source SHA + independent verifier; zero condition attested by the independent audit artifact itself

KILL_SWITCH_TEST.assertion_contract: Artifact records an executed kill-switch test during runtime operation, not code presence.
KILL_SWITCH_TEST.attestation_model: evidence_kind + artifact bytes at bound source SHA + independent verifier; tested execution recorded in the artifact

RECOVERY_TEST.assertion_contract: Artifact records an executed recovery test during runtime operation, not code presence.
RECOVERY_TEST.attestation_model: evidence_kind + artifact bytes at bound source SHA + independent verifier; tested execution recorded in the artifact
